component.name: LGL Papercutter
component.summary: Compose wallpapers for your desktop resolution

description.p: LGL Papercutter provides a visual, local workflow for positioning, resizing, and fitting wallpapers to a chosen display resolution.
Adds non-destructive batch exports, numbered output planning, itemised save previews, and independently staged target resolutions.
Initial release with visual wallpaper composition, resolution presets, verified backups, Save As, and in-app restoration.
